test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_comparisons_gaps (u64 UInt64, i32 Int32, i64 Int64, i128 Int128, f64 Float64, n Nullable(Int32), b Int32) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_comparisons_gaps SELECT cityHash64(number), toInt32(cityHash64(number, 1)), toInt64(cityHash64(number, 2)), toInt128(cityHash64(number, 3)) * 1000003, toFloat64(cityHash64(number, 4) % 100000000) / 13, if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 5))), toInt32(number % 1000) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM jit_comparisons_gaps WHERE u64 > i32 AND b + 1 > 5 SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT count() FROM jit_comparisons_gaps WHERE f64 > i64 OR f64 * 2 < 3 SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT count() FROM jit_comparisons_gaps WHERE i128 > 0 AND i128 * 2 < 1000000000000000 SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(toUInt32(n) + 1) FROM jit_comparisons_gaps SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(least(i32, b, n) + 1) FROM jit_comparisons_gaps SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(greatest(n, b) + 1) FROM jit_comparisons_gaps SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
